$comment: Parametric builder definitions. A builder is a reusable generator implemented once in each host: AutoCAD draws its 2D representation (block symbol for point builders, polyline/hatch for path and polygon builders) and SketchUp reconstructs its 3D geometry. Element types (element-types.json) reference a builder and override defaults. All lengths are metres, angles are degrees. Parameter 'type' is one of: length, number, integer, angle, bool, enum, text, material.

slab.description: Surface slab bounded by a closed boundary, top at boundary elevation + topOffset, extruded downward by thickness.

massing.description: Building or reference massing extruded from a footprint.

linear_slab.description: Strip of constant width along a centreline (roads, paths, markings, trenches).

wall.description: Wall, kerb, hedge or edging following an alignment, with optional strip footing.

fence.description: Posts at regular spacing along an alignment (straight and curved), with panels between posts.

channel.description: Linear drainage channel; path vertices define the grate (top) level.

pipe.description: Pipe, duct, cable or route along a path; axis offset vertically from the path (negative = buried).

tree.description: Tree with trunk and canopy. Botanical data must be supplied by the user; defaults are generic placeholders.

pole_mounted.description: Pole with an arm and a head unit (luminaire, camera, speaker, antenna). The arm points along local +X.

bench.description: Bench, chair or lounger. Length along local X; the seat front faces local -Y.

table.description: Table with optional attached benches on both long sides. Length along local X.

bike_stand.description: Row of bicycle hoops. Each hoop is parallel to local X; hoops repeat along local +Y at the given spacing.

box_equipment.description: Generic rectangular equipment or furniture body, centred on the insertion point. Use baseOffset for wall-mounted (positive) or buried (negative) items.

cylinder_equipment.description: Generic cylindrical body (bins, posts, pots, tanks, small lights).

underground_container.description: Underground or semi-underground waste container: buried body, top platform at cover level, insertion column above ground. Default dimensions are indicative only and must be replaced by manufacturer data.

parameters.label: Cover level offset from insertion elevation

chamber.description: Inspection chamber, manhole, valve or meter chamber. Insertion elevation = finished ground; cover level offset applies.

tank.description: Tank or cistern (box, horizontal or vertical cylinder), underground with cover depth or above ground.

parameters.label: Cover depth (ground to top of tank)

pergola.description: Pergola, carport or canopy on the oriented bounding rectangle of the footprint (first edge defines orientation): columns, perimeter beams, rafters or louvers and an optional cover.

shelter.description: Shelter, gazebo or pavilion centred on the insertion point; open side faces local -Y.

parking_bay.description: Parking or loading bay. Insertion point = centre of the access (aisle) edge; the bay extends along local +Y.

stripes.description: Striped marking area (pedestrian crossings, hatched areas). Stripes run parallel to the first boundary edge and repeat across the area, clipped to the boundary's oriented bounding rectangle.

arrow_marking.description: Painted direction arrow pointing along local +X, starting at the insertion point.

sign_post.description: Sign, information board or panel on one or two posts. The face is readable from local -Y.

gate.description: Gate or barrier. Insertion point = centre of the opening; the opening runs along local X; swing leaves open toward the chosen side.

pool.description: Basin with walls, floor and water surface. The boundary is the inner (water-side) edge at coping level.

planter.description: Raised planter: perimeter wall following the outer boundary, soil fill and optional planting mass.

planting_area.description: Planting bed, lawn or meadow: soil layer plus a simplified planting mass. Plant quantity can be estimated from spacing.

basin.description: Depression with sloped sides (retention/detention basin, rain garden, bioswale). The boundary is the top edge.

zone.description: Translucent zone volume (equipment zone, maintenance area, comfort zone, recycling island footprint).

circle_zone.description: Circular zone (root protection, safety envelope, illustrative coverage).

steps.description: Flight of steps on the oriented bounding rectangle of the boundary. The flight ascends away from the first boundary edge.

ramp.description: Ramp on the oriented bounding rectangle of the boundary, rising away from the first boundary edge.

swing.description: Swing frame with seats. Beam along local X.

cable_line.description: Cable between posts at the first and last path vertex (zip line).

solar_array.description: Ground-mounted PV array. Modules repeat along local +X; rows repeat along local +Y; modules face local -Y and tilt upward toward +Y.

vawt.description: Vertical-axis wind turbine: mast and cylindrical rotor envelope.

sail.description: Shade sail through 3 or 4 corner points with alternating high and low fixing heights and masts at the corners.

outline.description: Reference outline (site boundary, existing feature). Exported as edges without faces.

marker.description: Reference marker (building entrance, access point) pointing along local +X.

fountain.description: Round fountain basin with a water jet.

boulder.description: Decorative stone or boulder approximated by a faceted ellipsoid, partly embedded.
